titulo: How the Spanish Empire Went Broke: The Silver That Wasn't Enough

capitulos.titulo: A privateer and the silver fleet

descripcion:
It owned the richest silver mountain in the world, and still stopped paying its debts at least nine times between 1557 and 1666. Potosí and the mita, the piece of eight, the price revolution, Philip II's debts and the Great Armada, the expulsion of the Moriscos, the copper vellón cut in half by decree in 1628, and the end: Rocroi, Westphalia and the Pyrenees. Episode two of How Empires Fall. Images: public-domain and freely licensed works from Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
